jobs.description:
Full-Stack Developer Intern ﻿ About Appointohealth Appointohealth is a healthcare technology company focused on building modern digital solutions to make healthcare more accessible and convenient.
Role We are looking for a Full-Stack Developer Intern
to join our team.
This is a remote-friendly / location-flexible role (work from anywhere)
with optional on-site collaboration opportunities.
The intern will work on real-world web applications and contribute to both frontend and backend development.
Responsibilities Develop and maintain web applications.
Build responsive user interfaces.
Develop backend services and REST APIs.
Work with PostgreSQL databases.
Integrate frontend and backend services.
Fix bugs and improve application performance.

Work with the development team on real-world projects.
Follow coding and development best practices.

TypeScript
JavaScript
React.js
Tailwind CSS

Backend

Node.js

REST APIs

PostgreSQL

Tools

Additional Skills

Docker

Requirements Strong understanding of the required technologies.
Good problem-solving and debugging skills.

Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.

What You Will Get Hands-on experience with real-world projects.
Opportunity to work with modern technologies.
Mentorship and guidance from experienced developers.
Experience working in a professional development environment.
Opportunity to grow your technical and professional skills.

Location Remote (Work from Anywhere) + Optional On-site (Hyderabad)

Compensation This is a unpaid internship.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer Internship – MERN (Unpaid)
jobs.description:
About NoCapCode™

NoCapCode™ is a technology and product development company focused on building scalable digital products, SaaS platforms, internal systems, automation solutions, and modern web applications.
We are looking for a Full Stack Developer Intern with a strong foundation in the MERN stack, backend development, database architecture, and responsive web development.
This opportunity is designed for candidates who want to work on real-world development projects, contribute to existing applications, and gain practical experience with production-oriented engineering practices.

Role Overview

As a Full Stack Developer Intern, you will work across the application stack from developing responsive React interfaces to designing APIs, structuring backend services, and managing databases.
The ideal candidate should understand not only how to write code, but also how different parts of a web application communicate and how a maintainable software architecture is structured.

Key Responsibilities

Develop responsive and scalable web interfaces using React.js
Build and integrate RESTful APIs using Node.js and Express.js
Design and manage MongoDB/Mongoose schemas
Work with SQL databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL
Develop and maintain backend routes, controllers, services, and middleware
Implement frontend state management, props passing, and React Hooks
Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs
Implement authentication, authorization, validation, and error handling
Debug and resolve frontend, backend, API, and database-related issues
Work with existing codebases and understand established project architecture
Write clean, reusable, maintainable, and well-structured code
Use Git/GitHub for version control and collaborative development
Participate in technical discussions, code reviews, testing, and continuous improvement

Required Technical Skills

Frontend

React.js
JavaScript / ES6+
React Hooks
Props, State & Component Lifecycle
Responsive Web Development
HTML5 & CSS3
Tailwind CSS or equivalent
REST API integration

Backend

Node.js
Express.js
REST API development
Routes & Controllers
Middleware
Backend folder architecture
Authentication & Authorization
Request validation
Error handling

Database

MongoDB
Mongoose
Database schema design
CRUD operations
References and relationships
Aggregation pipelines
Basic SQL concepts
MySQL and/or PostgreSQL

Development Tools

Git & GitHub
Postman or equivalent API testing tools
Basic debugging and troubleshooting
Understanding of clean code and modular architecture

What We Expect

The candidate should be able to understand the complete application flow:
Frontend → API → Route → Controller → Service → Schema → Database → Response → Frontend

We particularly value candidates who can:
Understand and improve an existing codebase
Identify architectural and implementation issues
Write reusable components and backend modules
Design appropriate database schemas
Debug problems independently
Learn unfamiliar technologies when required
Communicate clearly with the development team
Take ownership of assigned technical tasks

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Internship

Employment type

Internship

Job function

Engineering and Information Technology

Industries

IT System Custom Software Development

jobs.title: Full Stack Web Developer Intern
jobs.description:
Full Stack Web Developer Intern (Paid)

Company: Zenithbyte

Location: Remote
Duration: 3 Months
For College Students Only!

Performance based stipend up-to 7500.00/-

This is a structured Career Launch Internship Program designed to help students gain practical project experience, mentorship, and industry exposure. The program includes guided learning resources, project evaluations, certificates, and performance-based opportunities.

Perks and benefits:

Performance based stipend up-to 7500.00/-

Certificate of Internship
Letter of Recommendation (based on performance)
Swags and goodies
Potential full-time role based on performance

Role Overview:

Work on live projects involving both front-end and back-end development. Gain hands-on experience with modern web technologies and build strong technical skills.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop and maintain responsive websites
Build dynamic web applications
Test, debug, and optimize applications
Collaborate with designers and developers

Eligibility:

Students or recent graduates in Computer Science, IT, or related fields with knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Familiarity with React, Angular, or Node.js is preferred.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Internship

Employment type

Internship

Industries

IT Services and IT Consulting, IT System Training and Support, and E-Learning Providers
